summary: Post-#348 authority mining found a distinct production/Studio module-load boundary gap: Bootstrap.server.luau now correctly rejects non-server context before dependency traversal, but every valid production server still requires PhysicsLabStudioHarness before the later RunService:IsStudio() branch. The harness explicitly declares itself Studio-only and performs a top-level require of PhysicsLabRealizer, so live servers unnecessarily load the Studio representation stack even though they never start it.
evidence: Authority PR #348 exact Bootstrap.server.luau loads PhysicsLabStudioHarness at top level immediately after shared dependencies, then only later executes `if RunService:IsStudio() then ... start(workspace) end`.

PhysicsLabStudioHarness.luau explicitly asserts `PhysicsLabStudioHarness is Studio-only validation tooling` in its public operations, but top-level module evaluation first requires PhysicsLabRealizer before that guard can run.

The existing #348 source-order regression covers server/client wrong-context rejection and client exclusion of server-only modules, but does not assert that a valid non-Studio server avoids importing Studio-only lab realization code.

No existing authority lane/event/PR was found for this production-vs-Studio require boundary. Recommended bounded source lane: move the Studio harness require behind the IsStudio branch (or an equivalent lazy Studio-only adapter boundary) and add a source/pure regression proving production bootstrap cannot load PhysicsLabStudioHarness/Realizer while preserving server ownership in Studio. This does not substitute for two-client Studio evidence.
